incident-bot: Pager: High error rate on prod embedding/reranker pipeline (INC-2026-0315-01). Service: embeddings-batch-prod -> reranker. 5xx spike starting ~1764871985. Affected route: POST /v1/embeddings/batch (client=reranker-service). Severity: P1. Paging oncall group @oncall-engineering :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): on it. acked pager. creating thread for mitigation notes.

maria (oncall): quick snapshot: 5m error rate jumped to ~18% (baseline <0.2%). Errors are mostly 500 from reranker when consuming embeddings. Some logs show: `InvalidVectorSize: expected 1536, got 1024`.

raj (infra): grabbing infra logs + recent deploys. any deploys in last hour?

deploy-bot: deploy completed: reranker-service v2026.3.15-84efe at 1764871200 -> deployed to prod-us-east. no rollbacks.

maria (oncall): ok we have a deploy before the spike. but the error mentions vector size mismatch — could be client or model change. sasha, can you check model variant + embedding dimension changes?

sasha (ml eng): checking model catalog + recent quantization changes. initial look: embedding model `redwood-embed-1.5` still set to dim=1536 in model registry. No schema change in model.

maria (oncall): copying logs from reranker consumer (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T12:33:05Z ERROR reranker-consumer: failed to decode embedding batch: InvalidVectorSize(expected=1536, got=1024) request_id=abc123 user_id=acct-45
2026-03-15T12:33:05Z WARN  reranker-consumer: dropping batch and returning 500 to caller request_id=abc123 route=/v1/serve_rerank
2026-03-15T12:33:06Z ERROR reranker-consumer: failed to process subsequent batch: InvalidVectorSize(expected=1536, got=1024) request_id=def456
```

maria (oncall): timeline so far:
- 1764871200 deploy reranker-service v2026.3.15-84efe
- 1764871985 first error spike observed (alerts fired)
- 1764872000 pager triggered

raj (infra): looking at ingress traces: batches are coming from `embeddings-batcher` (internal). Trace shows the batcher forwarded a payload with vectors of length 1024 to reranker. I can fetch the batcher logs.

raj (infra): batcher logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T12:30:52Z INFO embeddings-batcher: built batch size=32 target=reranker-service batch_id=b-77
2026-03-15T12:30:53Z DEBUG embeddings-batcher: embedding dims=1024 sample_ids=[...]
2026-03-15T12:30:53Z INFO embeddings-batcher: forward batch to reranker-service://10.3.4.12
```

maria (oncall): interesting — batcher is producing 1024-dim vectors. we need to know why. sasha, any client-side logic that could produce 1024 dims? maybe a fallback to a smaller model?

sasha (ml eng): checking recent client config. There was a feature flag rollout last night to enable `embed-fast-1` (dim=1024) for low-cost routing. The rollout was supposed to be for non-prod only, but I see a flag toggle happened at 1764870300 targeting "canary" that may have matched some prod traffic incorrectly. investigating targeting rules.

maria (oncall): hypothesis #1: feature-flag mis-targeting caused embeddings-batcher to request embed-fast-1 (1024d) for some requests, reranker expects 1536 (redwood-embed-1.5) -> mismatch -> 500s.

sasha (ml eng): hypothesis #2: deploy rolled newer reranker that validates embedding length strictly. Previously reranker tolerated variable dims (it would pad or map), new strict validation now throws. If both changed at similar times that explains spike.

maria (oncall): mitigation actions we can try now:
- rollback reranker to previous version (safe but could hide root cause)
- force embeddings-batcher to pin model to 1536 (apply quick config override)
- add validation shim in front of reranker to pad/convert 1024->1536 (hotfix)

maria (oncall): which is quickest? raj, can we pin batcher config quickly?

raj (infra): yes, we can roll a config override to batcher fleet to set EMBED_MODEL=redwood-embed-1.5. pushing now to ~10% first then 100% if green.

deploy-bot: config rollout started for service=embeddings-batcher config=EMBED_MODEL=redwood-embed-1.5 rollout_id=roll-2026-176487...

maria (oncall): nice. watch metrics for error rate. sasha, can you disable the feature flag while we assess?

sasha (ml eng): disabling flag now: ff-service:flag/embed_fast_1 targeting removed. Flip timestamp 1764872350.

rafael (cs): Rafael here — any ETA for fix? several customers reported re-ranking failures in the last 30m, including one enterprise tenant that saw batch job failures. I want to draft a short update.

maria (oncall): mitigation in progress: rolling batcher config -> pin to 1536. expect effect in ~2min per pool. I'll confirm when error rate drops. ETA 5–10m.

Tom (oncall) joins the thread by mention: ``@tom (oncall) I'm handing off after the config rolls, stay on for next hour pls``

tom (oncall): ack. I'll take next shift. brief summary for handoff: suspected feature flag sent 1024-dim embed model into prod; reranker validates dims and returns 500s; batcher config override applied; monitoring and customer comms in flight.

maria (oncall): monitoring update 1764872420: error rate dropped to 0.6% after override propagation. 5xx count trending towards baseline.

raj (infra): config rollout completed to 100% at 1764872440. no infra errors.

maria (oncall): marking mitigation=successful for now. next steps: full post-incident RCA, revert any temporary shims, verify client targeting rules, and identify why flag targeted prod. assign owners.

sasha (ml eng): owner for flag / targeting rules: sasha. I'll audit flag history and rollout service logs. preliminary note: target expression included `env in (staging, canary)` but a recent service name alias in prod matched canary rule — bug in targeting expression evaluation.

maria (oncall): owner for reranker strict validation change: raj + sasha to confirm whether validation was introduced in latest deploy. raj, can you find the change diff for reranker v2026.3.15-84efe?

raj (infra): diff shows a PR that added strict vector length validation: `if len(vec) != model.dim: raise InvalidVectorSize`. PR by @sasha 1764869000. It was merged and included in this deploy.

sasha (ml eng): that PR was intended to stop silent mis-runs for legacy clients. should have been gated behind a compatibility check. my mistake.

maria (oncall): owner for customer comms: rafael to send interim note. rafael, suggest language: short apology, mitigation summary, impact (some reranks failed between X and Y), and next steps.

rafael (cs): drafting: "We're aware some re-ranking requests returned errors between 12:33–12:44 UTC. Root cause under investigation; we've applied a mitigation to pin embeddings to the expected model and error rates are back to baseline. We'll follow up with a full RCA and any compensating actions. If you saw failed jobs, please share request IDs." Posting to affected customers.

maria (oncall): good. also note any internal action items to backlog: - add unit tests for flag targeting logic - require rollouts for validation changes to be behind compatibility opt-in - add metric to detect embedding dim mismatches earlier.

tom (oncall): handoff note for next shift: monitoring link: https://console/redwood/alerts/INC-2026-0315-01, key logs saved to GCS `s3://redwood-incident-logs/1764872000/`. If error resurfaces, revert shim or rollback reranker.

maria (oncall): marking incident mitigated at 1764872460. moving to post-incident RCA stage. adding checklist: timeline, root cause statement, contributing factors, action items, owners, verification plan.

sasha (ml eng): preliminary root cause: concurrent changes: (1) introduced strict validation in reranker deploy; (2) feature flag mis-targeting allowed embedding-batcher to select embed-fast-1 (1024d) for some prod traffic. The combination produced InvalidVectorSize and 500s.

raj (infra): logs + artifact links: reranker image digest: sha256:84efe... (deployed), batcher config rollback id roll-2026-176487... , flag history export: `gs://redwood-flags/exports/176487*.json`.

maria (oncall): action items assigned: 
- sasha: fix flag targeting rules + add test and canary (owner: sasha)
- sasha + raj: add compatibility gate for strict validation, or make validation configurable per model (owner: sasha, raj)
- infra: add early-detection metric for dim mismatch at ingress (owner: raj)
- cs: send customer follow-ups and compile impacted request IDs (owner: rafael)

rafael (cs): sent initial customer note at 1764872600. will follow with RCA when ready.

maria (oncall): final note before handing off to @tom: create RCA doc with timeline + logs + decisions and link to this thread. I'll add the incident channel and mark it triaged.

tom (oncall): taking over. thanks everyone. I'll pick up RCA doc draft and keep pinging owners for status. please add any spare logs or traces to the GCS folder.
